ask: Open a payment rail (Razorpay or owner choice) the company can use for product payment pages
why: No product the company builds can earn money until there is a way to get paid. The agents cannot open a payment account for you.
ifNo: Every product stays free and the company earns nothing.
title: Set up a way to take payments
youDo: Open a Razorpay account (or any payment provider you prefer) in your name, then comment approve. The agents will ask for a payment link per product when one is ready to sell.
